wallpaperConfig.name: Wallpaper Config
wallpaperConfig.description: A configuration to manage wallpapers used by the system, including desktop and lockscreen wallpapers for each screen and workspace.
wallpaperConfig.description[zh_CN]: 用于管理系统当前使用的壁纸配置，包括每个屏幕和工作区的桌面壁纸和锁屏壁纸。

glassEnabled.name: Glass Effect Enabled
glassEnabled.description: Use the Liquid Glass effect for backdrop blur regions instead of the plain blur. When disabled, the traditional Gaussian blur is used with no side effects.
glassEnabled.description[zh_CN]: 是否在背景模糊区域使用液态玻璃效果替代普通模糊。关闭时使用传统高斯模糊，无额外副作用。

blurStrength.name: Blur Strength
blurStrength.description: Maximum blur strength (in pixels) applied to the backdrop blur regions. When set to 0, blur is completely disabled. Range: 0-128.
blurStrength.description[zh_CN]: 背景模糊的最大强度（像素）。设置为 0 时将完全关闭模糊效果。范围：0-128。

glassBezel.name: Glass Bezel Width
glassBezel.description: The rounded edge bevel width in pixels for the Liquid Glass effect. Range: 2-60.
glassBezel.description[zh_CN]: 液态玻璃效果的圆角边缘倒角宽度（像素）。范围：2-60。

glassThickness.name: Glass Base Thickness
glassThickness.description: The glass thickness in pixels for Liquid Glass refraction. Range: 10.0-200.0.
glassThickness.description[zh_CN]: 液态玻璃折射使用的玻璃厚度（像素）。范围：10.0-200.0。

blurAmount.name: Blur Amount
blurAmount.description: Normalized blur amount applied by Qt MultiEffect. 0 disables the blur contribution while keeping the effect item alive; default 0.6 uses 60% of the configured blur strength. Range: 0.0-1.0.
blurAmount.description[zh_CN]: Qt MultiEffect 使用的归一化模糊量。0 表示关闭模糊贡献但保留效果项；默认 0.6 表示使用配置模糊强度的 60%。范围：0.0-1.0。

blurMultiplier.name: Blur Multiplier
blurMultiplier.description: Multiplier applied to extend the backdrop blur radius. 0 keeps Qt MultiEffect's default-quality blur radius; larger values extend the radius but reduce quality. Range: 0.0-4.0.
blurMultiplier.description[zh_CN]: 用于扩展背景模糊半径的倍率。0 表示使用 Qt MultiEffect 的默认质量模糊半径；值越大会扩展半径但降低质量。范围：0.0-4.0。

glassSaturation.name: Glass Saturation
glassSaturation.description: Saturation adjustment applied by Qt MultiEffect before Liquid Glass refraction. Range: -1.0-1.0.
glassSaturation.description[zh_CN]: 液态玻璃折射前由 Qt MultiEffect 应用的饱和度调节。范围：-1.0-1.0。

glassSpecular.name: Glass Specular
glassSpecular.description: Specular highlight intensity for the Liquid Glass rim and Fresnel response. 0 disables specular highlights. Range: 0.0-1.0.
glassSpecular.description[zh_CN]: 液态玻璃边缘高光与菲涅尔响应强度。0 表示关闭高光。范围：0.0-1.0。

glassProfilePower.name: Glass Profile Power
glassProfilePower.description: Surface profile exponent controlling the super-ellipse shape. 2 produces a rounder profile; higher values sharpen the bezel transition. Range: 1.0-10.0.
glassProfilePower.description[zh_CN]: 控制超椭圆形状的表面轮廓指数。2 产生更圆的轮廓；值越高边缘过渡越尖锐。范围：1.0-10.0。

lockscreenWallpaperDimEnabled.name: Lock Screen Wallpaper Dim
lockscreenWallpaperDimEnabled.description: Dim the lock screen and shutdown menu wallpaper so the login UI stays legible. When disabled the wallpaper is drawn untouched. The strength is controlled by lockscreenWallpaperDimRatio.
lockscreenWallpaperDimEnabled.description[zh_CN]: 压暗锁屏与电源/关机菜单壁纸，以保证登录界面清晰可读。关闭时壁纸原样显示，压暗强度由 lockscreenWallpaperDimRatio 控制。

lockscreenWallpaperDimRatio.name: Lock Screen Wallpaper Dim Ratio
lockscreenWallpaperDimRatio.description: Maximum dimming ratio applied to the lock screen and shutdown menu wallpaper when lockscreenWallpaperDimEnabled is on. The wallpaper is scaled by (1 - ratio * luma), so highlights are dimmed while hue and saturation are preserved. Set to 0 to disable dimming entirely. Range: 0.0-1.0.
lockscreenWallpaperDimRatio.description[zh_CN]: lockscreenWallpaperDimEnabled 开启时，锁屏与电源/关机菜单壁纸的最大压暗比例。壁纸按 (1 - 比例 * 亮度) 缩放，压暗高光的同时保持色相与饱和度不变。设置为 0 可完全关闭压暗效果。范围：0.0-1.0。

edgeSideTriggerDistance.name: Edge Side Trigger Distance
edgeSideTriggerDistance.description: Distance in pixels from the left/right screen edge at which half-screen tiling triggers
edgeSideTriggerDistance.description[zh_CN]: 距离屏幕左/右边缘多少像素时触发半屏平铺

edgeTopTriggerDistance.name: Edge Top Trigger Distance
edgeTopTriggerDistance.description: Distance in pixels from the top screen edge at which maximize triggers
edgeTopTriggerDistance.description[zh_CN]: 距离屏幕顶部边缘多少像素时触发最大化

edgeQuadrantZoneRatio.name: Edge Quadrant Zone Ratio
edgeQuadrantZoneRatio.name[zh_CN]: 四分之一屏触发区域比例
edgeQuadrantZoneRatio.description: Ratio of the edge length forming the corner (quadrant) tiling zone. Cursor within this ratio of the top/bottom of a side edge tiles to the corner quadrant, the middle zone keeps half-screen tiling. Range: 0.0-0.5
edgeQuadrantZoneRatio.description[zh_CN]: 边缘长度中形成四分之一屏（角落）平铺区域的比值。光标位于左右边缘的上/下该比例范围内时平铺到对应角落象限，中间区域保持半屏平铺。范围：0.0-0.5。

edgeInnerDelayMs.name: Edge Inner Delay
edgeInnerDelayMs.description: Delay in milliseconds before activating edge tiling on an inner edge between screens
edgeInnerDelayMs.description[zh_CN]: 多屏内边延迟激活边缘平铺的毫秒数

x11GtkIMModule.name: GTK Input Method Module (X11)
x11GtkIMModule.description: GTK input method module published through the XSettings Gtk/IMModule property, applied by GTK2/3/4 applications running on X11, including XWayland. Wayland GTK applications pick their input method through the Wayland text-input protocol and ignore this value. A colon separated list of modules is allowed. An empty value does not remove the property: GTK then falls back to locale based automatic selection and ignores gtk-im-module from the user's settings.ini.
x11GtkIMModule.description[zh_CN]: 通过 XSettings 的 Gtk/IMModule 属性发布的 GTK 输入法模块，作用于运行在 X11（含 XWayland）上的 GTK2/3/4 应用。Wayland 下的 GTK 应用通过 text-input 协议获取输入法，不使用该值。允许以冒号分隔多个模块。空字符串并不会移除该属性：此时 GTK 回退为按 locale 自动选择，用户 settings.ini 中的 gtk-im-module 不会生效。

lockscreen.name: Login and lock screen
lockscreen.description: Control content slides, background transitions and control button resizing on login and lock screens. Level at which this item turns on: 0=none (always off), 1=low (on at low/medium/high, off at none), 2=medium (on at medium/high, off at low/none), 3=high (on at high only, off at medium/low/none). Enabled when system effectLevel >= this value (and != 0). Range: 0-3. Takes effect immediately.
lockscreen.description[zh_CN]: 统一控制登录与锁屏界面的内容滑动、背景过渡和控制按钮尺寸变化。表示该项从哪个档位开始开启：0=none（始终关闭），1=low（在 low/medium/high 开启，none 关闭），2=medium（在 medium/high 开启，low/none 关闭），3=high（仅 high 开启，medium/low/none 关闭）。当系统 effectLevel >= 该值（且不为 0）时开启，低于该值时关闭。范围：0-3。实时生效。

windowOpen.name: Window open animation
windowOpen.description: Animate normal window opening. Disabling opens the window immediately. Level at which this item turns on: 0=none (always off), 1=low (on at low/medium/high, off at none), 2=medium (on at medium/high, off at low/none), 3=high (on at high only, off at medium/low/none). Enabled when system effectLevel >= this value (and != 0). Range: 0-3. Takes effect immediately.
windowOpen.description[zh_CN]: 控制普通窗口打开动画；关闭时窗口立即显示。表示该项从哪个档位开始开启：0=none（始终关闭），1=low（在 low/medium/high 开启，none 关闭），2=medium（在 medium/high 开启，low/none 关闭），3=high（仅 high 开启，medium/low/none 关闭）。当系统 effectLevel >= 该值（且不为 0）时开启，低于该值时关闭。范围：0-3。实时生效。

Enabled when system effectLevel >= this value (and != 0). Range: 0-3. Takes effect immediately.
windowClose.description[zh_CN]: 控制普通窗口关闭动画；关闭时窗口立即关闭。表示该项从哪个档位开始开启：0=none（始终关闭），1=low（在 low/medium/high 开启，none 关闭），2=medium（在 medium/high 开启，low/none 关闭），3=high（仅 high 开启，medium/low/none 关闭）。当系统 effectLevel >= 该值（且不为 0）时开启，低于该值时关闭。范围：0-3。实时生效。

maximize.name: Maximize animation
maximize.description: Animate the geometry change when maximizing. Disabling applies the maximized geometry immediately. Level at which this item turns on: 0=none (always off), 1=low (on at low/medium/high, off at none), 2=medium (on at medium/high, off at low/none), 3=high (on at high only, off at medium/low/none). maximize.description[zh_CN]: 控制最大化几何变化动画；关闭时立即应用最大化几何。表示该项从哪个档位开始开启：0=none（始终关闭），1=low（在 low/medium/high 开启，none 关闭），2=medium（在 medium/high 开启，low/none 关闭），3=high（仅 high 开启，medium/low/none 关闭）。当系统 effectLevel >= 该值（且不为 0）时开启，低于该值时关闭。范围：0-3。实时生效。

fullscreen.description[zh_CN]: 控制进入全屏的几何变化动画；关闭时立即应用全屏几何。表示该项从哪个档位开始开启：0=none（始终关闭），1=low（在 low/medium/high 开启，none 关闭），2=medium（在 medium/high 开启，low/none 关闭），3=high（仅 high 开启，medium/low/none 关闭）。当系统 effectLevel >= 该值（且不为 0）时开启，低于该值时关闭。范围：0-3。实时生效。

Level at which this item turns on: 0=none (always off), 1=low (on at low/medium/high, off at none), 2=medium (on at medium/high, off at low/none), 3=high (on at high only, off at medium/low/none). Enabled when system effectLevel >= this value (and != 0). Range: 0-3. Takes effect immediately.
restoreWindow.description[zh_CN]: 控制从最大化或全屏还原的几何变化动画；关闭时立即应用还原几何。表示该项从哪个档位开始开启：0=none（始终关闭），1=low（在 low/medium/high 开启，none 关闭），2=medium（在 medium/high 开启，low/none 关闭），3=high（仅 high 开启，medium/low/none 关闭）。当系统 effectLevel >= 该值（且不为 0）时开启，低于该值时关闭。范围：0-3。实时生效。

Level at which this item turns on: 0=none (always off), 1=low (on at low/medium/high, off at none), 2=medium (on at medium/high, off at low/none), 3=high (on at high only, off at medium/low/none). minimize.description[zh_CN]: 控制窗口最小化动画；关闭时立即最小化，不播放缩小过渡。表示该项从哪个档位开始开启：0=none（始终关闭），1=low（在 low/medium/high 开启，none 关闭），2=medium（在 medium/high 开启，low/none 关闭），3=high（仅 high 开启，medium/low/none 关闭）。当系统 effectLevel >= 该值（且不为 0）时开启，低于该值时关闭。范围：0-3。实时生效。

restoreMinimized.description[zh_CN]: 控制最小化窗口的恢复动画；关闭时立即恢复。表示该项从哪个档位开始开启：0=none（始终关闭），1=low（在 low/medium/high 开启，none 关闭），2=medium（在 medium/high 开启，low/none 关闭），3=high（仅 high 开启，medium/low/none 关闭）。当系统 effectLevel >= 该值（且不为 0）时开启，低于该值时关闭。范围：0-3。实时生效。

showDesktop.description[zh_CN]: 控制显示桌面时隐藏窗口的动画；关闭时立即隐藏。表示该项从哪个档位开始开启：0=none（始终关闭），1=low（在 low/medium/high 开启，none 关闭），2=medium（在 medium/high 开启，low/none 关闭），3=high（仅 high 开启，medium/low/none 关闭）。当系统 effectLevel >= 该值（且不为 0）时开启，低于该值时关闭。范围：0-3。实时生效。
